# Synthetic reproduction fixture

All companies, disclosures, accessions and filing URLs in this fixture are fictional.
These are SEC-shaped engineering examples, not source reconciliations or empirical findings.
The input arrays live in generate.py; hand-worked expectations live in expectations.json.
Example A latest: revenue 200m; prior restated revenue 160m; operating income 60m;
OCF 70m; PP&E cash purchases 10m; SBC 20m; basic shares 110m vs 108m.
Thus growth 25%; operating margin 30%; FCF margin 30%; SBC intensity 10%;
basic share growth 1.85185185185185%; operating margin change 5pp.
Example B tests ambiguity, missing investment, wrong units and instant-vs-duration.
Example C tests a reporting gap, unreconciled share split and investment scope.
